paragraphs: Acha. Rav Abba bar Acha; Rav Adda, son of Acha; Rav Bibi; Rav Huna; Rabbi Chiyya; Rav Chana; Rabbi Yaakov; Rabbi Yitzchak; Rabbi Yirmeyah; Rav Shmuel bar Acha.

Since Yuchasin takes the unqualified Rav Acha to be the brother of Abba, Rabbi Yirmeyah’s father, while I do not know who the unqualified Rav Acha with Ravina is, I have arranged those mentioned with the unqualified Rav Acha.

Rabbi Abba, father of Rabbi Abba Mari; Rabbi Abba in his name, Shekalim, chapter 3. He asked Rabbi Abba. Abaye spoke to him, Sanhedrin 20, end of b. Rabbi Avin; Rav Avya the elder. Rabbi Oshaya in his name, Berakhot 3b; in Rabbi Hoshaya’s name, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Eruvin. In Rabbi Elyakum’s name. He said in Rabbi Elazar’s name, Megillah 18a. Rabbi Elazar of Botzra in his name. Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Tzadok in his generation (see there). In Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Chalafta’s name, Vayikra Rabbah, section 27; the same subject, Midrash Kohelet on “What has been already is,” has Rabbi Acha in Rabbi Chalafta’s name. Apparently both places are erroneous and should read in Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chalafta’s name. Rabbi Bon bar Kohen or bar Kahana; Rabbi Bisna in his name; Rabbi Binyamin bar Giddel; Rabbi Gershon in his name; Rabbi Dosa of Mallachya; Rabbi Huna; Rabbi Huna the priest in his name; in Rabbi Hoshaya’s name (see Oshaya). He said in Rabbi Zeira’s name; Rabbi Chizkiyah in his name; Rabbi Chiyya bar Adda; Rabbi Chilkiyah in his name; Rabbi Chanina Yaut; in Rabbi Chinena’s name, Jerusalem Talmud, end of the first chapter of Eruvin. Rabbi Chisda in his name; in Rabbi Chisday’s name, Jerusalem Talmud, there. In Rabbi Yehudah’s name, Berakhot 13b; Rabbi Yehudah son of Rabbi Simon. In Rabbi Yehudah ben Levi’s name. Rabbi Yehudah ben Pazi. Rabbi Yudan asked him, Midrash Rabbah, beginning of the opening discourse to Eikhah. Rabbi Yehudah Gizray; Rabbi Yehudah bar Titom; Rabbi Yehudah bar Sinena in his name. Rabbi Yehoshua in his name, Midrash Rabbah, beginning of the opening discourse to Eikhah. In Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name, Jerusalem Talmud; in Rabbi Yannai’s name; Rabbi Yannai the Cappadocian; in Rabbi Yose ben Nehorai’s name. Rabbi Yisna; Rabbi Yose bar Yaakov in his name; Rabbi Yaakov bar Avyah in his name. In Rabbi Kahana’s name, Chullin 93b and Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Eruvin. In Rabbi Levi’s name, Berakhot 60b; in Rabbi Meyasha’s name. Meremar. Rav Nachman in his name, Midrash Rabbah, beginning of the opening discourse to Eikhah; Rabbi Nechemyah in his name, Midrash Rabbah, there. He asked Rabbi Simon. In Rabbi Akiva’s name, Tosefta, end of Shabbat, chapter 16, and end of Kelim, chapter 6. Pashpasha asked him. Rabbi Redifa; Rabbi Shayin before him; Rabbi Shimon ben Zevid (see there); in Resh Lakish’s name. Rabbi Shimon ben Karsena in his name. Rabbi Shmuel the elder before him; Rabbi Shmuel bar Unaya; Rabbi Shmuel bar Bina in his name; Rabbi Shmuel bar Mina; Rabbi Shmuel bar Yannai in his name; in Rabbi Simlai’s name; in Rabbi Tanchum bar Chiyya’s name. Rabbi Tanchum in his name; Rabbi Tefray in his name.
[Glosses: Acha. (a) Chullin 49a: Rav Acha bar Natan and Mar Zutra bar Mari should read Rav Acha bar Rav; likewise correct Rif and Asheri. The new editions did not correct it, leaving room for correction. See what I wrote in Seder Tannaim ve-Amoraim under Rav Acha bar Rav, and understand. (b) Kiddushin 81, end of b: Rav Acha Abba, Rav Chisda’s father-in-law; the new editions have another reading, Chanan bar Rava. (c) Shabbat 113, end of b: Rav Acha bar Abba; Ein Yaakov has bar Adda, while Asheri mentions no Rabbi Acha, only Rabbi Chiyya bar Ashi. (d) Berakhot 14a: Rabbi Acha, son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, said in Rabbi Chiyya’s name in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. It should read in Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba’s name in Rabbi Yochanan’s name; alternatively, Rabbi Abba son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba. (e) Kiddushin 66, end of a: Rav Acha bar Rav Minyomi. I think Rav is erroneous and should read bar Minyomi; the new editions did not correct it. (f) Bava Kamma 114b: Rav Acha Kartigenai; Berakhot 33: Karchinai. (g) Zevachim 61b: Rav Acha bar Ammi; Avodah Zarah at פ״ק א׳ [locator unresolved], and Yoma 84a: bar Rav Ammi; not corrected. (h) Berakhot 3, end of b: Rabbi Acha bar Bizna; I think Chana should be read; not corrected. (i) Bava Kamma 22, end of a: Rav Huna bar Manoach in Rav Ika’s name; I think in Rav Acha bar Ika’s name should be read; not corrected. Yevamot 43a: in Rav Idi bar Rav Ika’s name should read Acha; not corrected. (j) Zevachim 11b: Rav Acha son of Rava in Rabbi Yannai’s name; perhaps son of Rav should be read; not corrected. (k) Eruvin 90b: Rav Achi son of Rav; I think Acha son of Rava should be read, as in the Amsterdam edition. (l) Shabbat 79b: Rav Achi bar Chanina; I think Acha should be read; not corrected.]
